_help: Care Packages shown ONLY when the live backend is unavailable (the live packages always win when it answers). Edit this file to add or change them. Each entry: id = a unique NEGATIVE whole number (-1, -2, ...). enabled = false hides an entry without deleting it (leave out to mean true). name is required; the site groups cards into Individual, Couples and Assessments by words in the name ("Couple", "Assessment"). sessionCount = how many sessions the package includes (a whole number, 1 or more; 1 shows as a single session). price = the STARTING price in whole currency units for the whole package, e.g. 700000 for Rp 700,000 — the site always shows it as "Start from". currency = a 3-letter code such as "USD" or "IDR"; IDR is shown as Rp 700,000 and USD with a $ sign. discountPercent = the saving, 1 to 99, or null for none (informational only; the price is not recalculated). description = one or two short lines shown on the card (leave "" for none). badge = a short label such as "Most Popular" (leave "" for none). The cards are shown in the order listed here. translations.id (optional, per package): Indonesian description and badge shown when the visitor reads the site in Bahasa Indonesia; a missing field shows the English one. Names stay as written (they are brand names and the Couples/Assessments grouping reads them). The current Indonesian text is a machine-drafted DRAFT that still needs review by an Indonesian speaker.
